WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT s.telescref AS telescope_id,
         o.weathprofile AS weather_condition,
         AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
         AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry COLLATE BINARY
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY
  GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modulation_index) AS overall_avg_modulation_index
  FROM step1
)
SELECT step1.weather_condition,
       AVG(step1.avg_modulation_index),
       AVG(step1.avg_phase_shift),
       AVG(step1.avg_modulation_index - step2.overall_avg_modulation_index)
FROM step1
JOIN step2
  ON step2.overall_avg_modulation_index IS NOT NULL
WHERE step1.avg_modulation_index > step2.overall_avg_modulation_index
GROUP BY step1.weather_condition
